name: voomate
description: Voice-first AI agent platform for websites — multi-tenant SaaS

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @voomate/i18n && npm run build -w @voomate/core && npm run build -w @voomate/db && npm run build -w @voomate/connect
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @voomate/api && npm run build -w @voomate/widget && npm run build -w @voomate/dashboard && npm run build -w @voomate/landing
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:verify: npm run verify:rls --workspace @voomate/db && npm run verify:retrieval --workspace @voomate/db
scripts.dev:voice: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; cd services/voice && uv run bot.py --transport webrtc --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7860
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.eval:web-agent: LOG_LEVEL=warn PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 promptfoo eval -c evals/web-agent/promptfooconfig.yaml --env-file .env --no-cache --max-concurrency 1 --delay 3000 --output evals/web-agent/results/latest.json --output evals/web-agent/results/latest.html
scripts.eval:web-agent:baseline: LOG_LEVEL=warn PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 WEB_AGENT_HARNESS_FILE=../../apps/dashboard/harness/web-agent.v1.0.0.md promptfoo eval -c evals/web-agent/promptfooconfig.yaml --env-file .env --no-cache --max-concurrency 1 --delay 1200 --output evals/web-agent/results/baseline.json
scripts.smoke:connect: npm run build -w @voomate/connect && npm run build -w @voomate/connect-store-example && node scripts/smoke-connect.mjs
scripts.test:voice-service: cd services/voice && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check .
